run_BaseInferencer_call: run inference on inputs by calling a BaseInferencer subclass with model and batch size
build_BaseInferencer_subclass: build a custom inferencer subclass that implements _init_pipeline, visualize, and postprocess methods
test_BaseInferencer_preprocess: test the preprocess method to chunk and collate input data for model inference
review_BaseInferencer_dispatch_kwargs: review the _dispatch_kwargs method that routes keyword arguments to preprocess, forward, visualize, and postprocess
list_BaseInferencer_models: list available pretrained models by calling the list_models static method with an optional pattern
